CC: painful callus on the foot
HPI: weeks of symptoms relating to multiple painful calluses.
Exam: plantar callus area consistent with multiple painful calluses. Separately identified: tenderness at a distinct anatomic location with documented quality, palpable swelling, and pain on resisted motion.
MDM: discussed risks and benefits of the planned procedure; patient consents.
Procedure: Paring of multiple hyperkeratotic lesions performed (LT modifier documented). Tolerated well, no immediate complications.
